assumptions: CLI `vmaf`/`vmaf-neg` -> crates/vmaf VmafV0Scorer (v0_score.rs:103-129) on U8 planar YUV420 luma only. Per-pair features: adm2 (4-scale ADM), vif_scales[4], motion2 = 0 for a single frame pair (v0_score.rs:119; score() only computes motion across consecutive frames).

Ingress: api requires Planar YUV420 U8 (metric.rs:123-145); rgb8 input is converted by shared ingress to YUV420 -> counted as 5-mul luma + quarter-res chroma (chroma planes unused by compute but materialized).
Model vmaf_v0.6.1.json: LIBSVMNUSVR, 6 features, 211 support vectors, RBF kernel (v0.rs:36,95); predict = 6 rescale fma + 211*(6 sub + 6 mul + 5 add + gamma-mul + exp + alpha fma) + clip.

ADM (adm.rs compute_adm:5593): 4 scales, floor-halving (w.div_ceil(2)). Per scale: adm_dwt2 separable 4-tap integer DWT (u16/i32 -> 3 i16 band planes + i32 downsampled a_out for next scale), adm_decouple (Watson decoupling, div via 65537-entry LUT), adm_csf (rfactor scaling, i16 for scale 0 / i32 for 1-3), adm_cm contrast masking (Watson inner product, per-band accumulator loops with row-window cs/win buffers), csf_den accumulation. Per-el op counts are scalar-semantics approximations of the SIMD kernels (v3/v4x paths counted as scalar).

VIF (vif.rs statistics:3510, vif_v0_from_luma:3934): 4 scales with Gaussian filters TAPS=[17,9,5,3] (FILTERS:17-26). Per scale: vertical pass accumulates 5 statistics (ref mean, dis mean, ref sq, dis sq, ref*dis) with T taps each -> int 5T madd + 2T loads per px; horizontal pass reduces 5 column accumulators -> 5T; finalize ~20 ops with log-table LUTs (log_table:45, power-of-2 fast path). subsample uses next filter on both images.
Ops below are per-element averages over band/scale structure (documented approximation); border regions mirror-clamped, same op count.
vmaf-neg tally: identical compute, StandardNeg model (v0.rs:37) - same 211-SV structure.

stages.name: RGB8 -> YUV420 u16 (luma + quarter chroma)
stages.notes: Y per px + U/V at N/4 each (folded: ~1.5x luma cost amortized to 1 el); chroma discarded by features.

stages.name: ADM DWT vertical pass (lo/hi rows)
stages.notes: Fixed-point 1-D vertical wavelet pass emitting lo/hi row planes (adm_dwt2.cpp vertical filtering); intermediate planes are full image size.

stages.name: ADM DWT horizontal pass (3 bands + decimated a_out)
stages.notes: Horizontal 1-D pass: 4 half-width outputs (3 band planes + a_out) per input pair; emits ~2 stores per input element.

stages.name: Watson decouple ref/dis bands (a, r)
stages.notes: Orientation decoupling: inner products, div_lookup rcp, sign/angle masks; ~26 int ops per band el (avg over i16 s0 / i32 s123 paths).

stages.name: CSF rfactor scaling + flt, 3 bands
stages.notes: mul + shift + add + clamp per el + flt copy.

stages.name: contrast masking num/den accumulation, 3 bands
stages.notes: Watson inner-product accumulation per band via row-window buffers; rfactor shifts; sums folded to scalar num/den per scale.

stages.name: csf_f + den scale + final num/den per scale
stages.notes: csf_f denominator path; per-scale reduce into aim_num/den accumulators.

stages.name: VIF decimation horizontal pass
stages.notes: Separable FIR horizontal pass writing a full intermediate plane (vif_filter1d h-pass).

stages.name: VIF decimation vertical pass
stages.notes: Vertical pass producing the decimated plane (full).

stages.name: vertical 5-stat accumulation (T taps)
stages.notes: T={17,9,5,3} per scale avg 8.5: 2T loads + 5T madd -> folded avg ld 17 int 42.

stages.name: sigma clamp + num/den log-accumulate per px
stages.notes: SIGMA_NSQ clamps, g = min(1, sv_sq/sigma_nsq), num/den accumulate via log2 LUT (power-of-2 int ops counted as log).

stages.name: nu-SVR RBF predict: 6 rescale + 211 SVs
stages.notes: Per SV: dist2 = 6 sub+6 mul+5 add, exp(-g*d2), alpha fma. Model rescale/clip ~20 flops once (folded).
